tagline: Upload PDF files to a conversation (Beta): You can now upload PDF files to a Genie One conversation alongside CSV and Excel files.
what_it_does: Upload PDF files to a conversation (Beta): You can now upload PDF files to a Genie One conversation alongside CSV and Excel files. Genie One parses PDFs asynchronously. Mention workspace users in document comments: In a document, you can now mention workspace users in a comment.
why_it_matters: This generates more accurate responses and reduces latency by reducing the amount of data Genie One needs to crawl and query.
